properties.site-address: Howard of Effingham School & Lodge Farm, Lower Rd & Browns Field, Browns Lane, Effingham, Leatherhead, KT24
properties.notes: Application ref. 14/P/02109. Hybrid planning application for outline permission (only access to be considered) for the erection of a replacement secondary school for Howard of Effingham and up to 258 residential dwellings with means of access at Howard of Effingham School and Lodge Farm, Lower Road following demolition of all existing buildings; and full permission for the erection of 37 dwellings, with access, parking and landscaping works on land at Brown's Field, Brown's Lane, Effingham.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
